title: Fetch-depth clamp and the fetch-pack earliest gate
severity_reason: A fetch-pack root below getEarliestFetch is refused with feeMalformedRequest, and the clamp means online_delete (256) binds before fetch_depth does at the default. With fetch_depth narrowed to 100, the earliest fetch rises to 1900 and two more roots are refused.
notes: Part 1 uses the default fetch_depth (clamped to online_delete 256, earliest 1744). Part 2 switches fetch_depth to 100; this stands in for a second node started with [fetch_depth] 100, because the clamp arithmetic (SHAMapStoreImp.h:129) is the same function either way. Roots 1000 and 1500 are refused for a different reason: the node does not hold those ledgers at all.
